svg.title: Xenopus frog
svg.desc: Adult Xenopus frog in dorsal three-quarter view with a flattened aquatic body, small forelimbs, muscular webbed hindlimbs, and mottled skin. Biological basis: Xenopus frogs produce large externally developing embryos that permit manipulation and imaging in developmental, cell, and molecular biology.
